15. It is hereby declared that
sections 292, 293, and 294 of the Se Merchant Shipping Act (17 and 18 Vict.,
cap. 104)****, and Schedule S of that Act
are and shall be applicable to all steam-vessels proceeding A to sea from any
port or place in *****[* *Sind] and that, in
calculating the penalties mentioned in the said section 293, ten rupees be
taken as the equivalent for one pound sterling.
****See now the Merchant Shipping
Act, 1894 (57 and 58 Vict., cap. 60).
*****Omitted by the central laws A.
O. 1964 for the words "the province of" which was previously subs. by
Sind 5 of 1955, S. 7, Sch. III, for presidency of Bombay or its
Dependences".
